correctness.rationale: Independently re-verified from artifacts with numpy: G0 equals K8 exactly; all Gi are 7-regular and BFS-connected; each G(i+1) rebuilt from (Gi, signing) by the Bilu-Linial recipe matches stored edges exactly (maxdiff 0); dense eigvalsh gives nontrivial maxima 1.0, 3.0, 3.62252, 3.87541, 4.24374, 4.53605, all below 2*sqrt(6)=4.898979 with smallest margin 0.363, far above roundoff; sympy charpoly of the K8 signing factors exactly as (x-3)^3(x-1)(x+1)(x+3)^3. Certificate logic (spectrum-union, connectivity) is sound.

originality.rationale: Fused 3-direction search plus full-text inspection shows no prior source covers the explicit six-level two-sided 7-regular 2-lift tower from K8 (n=8..256) or its exact G1 signing: Morgenstern/LPS require d-1 prime power so exclude d=7; MSS/Hall-Puder-Sawin give only one-sided/bipartite lifts; Mohanty-O'Donnell-Paredes gives only near-Ramanujan (2*sqrt(6)+eps) infinite families and states exact d=7 Ramanujan is unknown; the Zenodo 7-regular census stops at 14 vertices. The concrete certified chain is therefore new and not mechanically implied.

value.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING genuinely derived from the admitted infinite-tower target (same K8 base, same 2-lift operation, same two-sided bound). It is an exact, motivated invariant of a natural object in a recognized open case (d=7 excluded from LPS/Morgenstern; two-sided Bilu-Linial open): first explicit multi-level two-sided 7-regular chain with machine-checkable certificates, quantified shrinking margins (1.899 to 0.363), and an exact-integer-spectrum first lift future work on the infinite tower can reuse. Not a textbook fact, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
